[P17] 可是孟母注意【^】
  proposed by the AI checker: 可是孟母注意[+到] (注意到 means “notice/realize” a fact)
  proposed by the correction model: 可是孟母注意[+到]
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 可是孟子的妈妈[+就]有别的看法 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿

  her past correction (adversative_connector): [-可是]孟子的妈妈一直很控制他
  rule card conditional_jiu: Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future. Not an error: When you mean “sometimes,” use 有的时候, not 只要……就. 会 is appropriate when you mean “will” in the future.
  rule card adversative_connector: Use 可是, 却, 而, and 但 only when there is a real “semantic turn,” such as a contrast or an unexpected result. 却 indicates an unexpected semantic turn. Not an error: Use 却 when the result is an unexpected semantic turn.

Not an error: Do not flag 却 merely because it is formal; use it when there is an unexpected semantic turn. Do not use 本+N. when it would incorrectly imply that the author owns the noun.
  rule card word_class_choice: Choose the word class and form that the structure needs: use nouns as nouns, verbs as verbs, and Adj. where an adjective is needed. Follow fixed patterns such as 很多+noun and 这个 + Noun; 据说 goes at sentence initial, separate from the information heard. Not an error: Do not flag 文明 when it is used as an Adj. meaning “civilized.”

  rule card conditional_jiu: Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future. Not an error: When you mean “sometimes,” use 有的时候, not 只要……就. 会 is appropriate when you mean “will” in the future.

[P20] 所以孟母决定【他们会】搬家
  proposed by the AI checker: 所以孟母决定[-他们会]搬家 (决定搬家 does not take 他们会 here)
  proposed by the correction model: 所以孟母决定他们[-会]搬家
  her past correction (haide_harmful_result): ⟦这害得孟母决定搬家⟧ — her note: “害得“ is followed by something harmful, 搬家is not harmful
  her past correction (le_completed): 所以妈妈跟孟子一起搬家[+了] — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (cause_result_soyi): [-所以]妈妈跟孟子一起搬家
  rule card haide_harmful_result: Use 害得 + N/sb. + harmful result (or a harmful clause). The result must be genuinely harmful: neutral events such as 搬家 or 玩儿, and mild feelings such as 不高兴, do not fit after 害得. Not an error: Do not use this rule for a neutral event such as 搬家 or 玩儿, or for a merely mild feeling such as 不高兴; these are not harmful results for 害得.
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
